name: const unsafe fn borrow_raw (fd : RawFd) -> Self
rule: The resource pointed to by `fd` must remain open for the duration of the returned `BorrowedFd`.
api: impl  std::os::fd::owned::BorrowedFd < '_ > { const unsafe fn borrow_raw (fd : std::os::fd::owned::RawFd) -> Self }
expression: This requirement is not expressible in the supplied DSL: it provides no observation of whether a file descriptor is open and cannot express that it remains open for the returned borrow’s duration.
